violations.title: Chemical Sanitization, Quaternary Ammonium Requirements
violations.observation: When tested, the quaternary ammonium compound-based sanitizing solution was observed to be at a concentration less than what is required for effective sanitization of food-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils. Observed the sanitizing solution in the sanitizer buckets and 3-compartment sink filled at the chemical dispenser with a concentration of less than 150ppm total quaternary ammonium compound.
violations.corrective_action: The quaternary ammonium sanitizer used in this facility shall have a minimum concentration of at least 200 ppm OR a concentration between 150-400ppm based on the manufacturer's use directions and using the appropriate test kit. Manager mixed sanitizer solution by hand. This method will be used and sanitizer will be tested prior to placing in the buckets or filling the sink. It is recommended to obtain service for the chemical dispenser.
